status: mass+x-y-time-only feasibility preflight frozen before vertical transfer outcomes
role: post-freeze exploratory morphology mechanism test; cannot alter v0.3.8 submission claims
ecological_hypothesis: If body size contributes to individual vertical organization, profiles from conspecific donors with body mass closer to the target should predict the target's centered vertical states better than profiles from mass-dissimilar donors.

mass.donor_partition: Within each target individual's frozen cohort, exclude the target, rank other individuals by absolute animal-mass difference, break ties lexicographically by donor ID, and split the ordered donors into a closer half and farther half. The closer half contains ceil(n_other/2) donors and the farther half the remaining floor(n_other/2).

feasibility.structural_support: For each target session, derive frozen 5-km cell × speed2_turn2 strata using x-y-time only. A target endpoint is supported if its stratum occurs in at least one session from a closer-mass donor and at least one session from a farther-mass donor in the same cohort.
feasibility.individual_evaluable: at least one target session with >=50 common supported endpoints
feasibility.required_panel_retention: at least 70% of the kinematic-state-conditioned evaluable n and at least 5 individuals in every panel
feasibility.decision: If every panel passes, freeze exact evaluable n before opening vertical outcomes; otherwise stop the five-panel mass-transfer family.

planned_test_if_feasible.endpoint: mean target log P_close_mass(z_residual | cell,state) - log P_far_mass(z_residual | cell,state), scored only on target events supported by both donor pools
planned_test_if_feasible.donor_weighting: equal session within donor, then equal donor within close/far group
planned_test_if_feasible.aggregation: equal target session within target individual, then equal individual within panel
planned_test_if_feasible.null: permute animal-mass labels among eligible individuals within frozen cohort, rebuild close/far donor groups, and recompute the complete panel statistic
planned_test_if_feasible.panel_support_rule: observed close-minus-far gain > 0 and one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05
planned_test_if_feasible.synthesis: 4 or 5 panels support => body-mass similarity is a general predictor of vertical organization; 2 or 3 => context-dependent; 0 or 1 => simple body-mass similarity is not a general mechanism.

claim_boundary: Animal mass is not wing loading or full morphology.
A positive transfer effect would be associative, not causal.
A negative result would not rule out wing shape, age, experience or other stable traits.
This extension remains outside the frozen v0.3.8 submission package.
stop_rule: Do not change close/far split, 50-event support, 70% retention, kinematic-state definition, panel set, permutation count/seeds or pass rules after preflight/output.
Do not substitute tag mass or sex if animal mass fails.
Do not drop a panel after seeing preflight or vertical outcomes.
